en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਕਾਲਕੂਟੁ ਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sair vichahu nikalai kaalakooT tai a(n)mirat vaanee|

en.bdb: Deadly poison and nectar both were churned out of the ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਰਿ ਮੁਕੀਐ ਉਤ ਖਾਧੈ ਹੁਇ ਅਮਰੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: aut khaadhai mar mukeeaai ut khaadhai hui amar paraanee|

en.bdb: Taking poison, one, dies whereas taking the other, (nectar) man becomes immortal.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸੁ ਵਸੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਸਪ ਦੈ ਗਰੜ ਦੁਗਾਰਿ ਅਮਿਅ ਰਸ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: vis vasai muh sap dhai garaR dhugaar amia ras jaanee|

en.bdb: Poison resides in the mouth of snake and the jewel eructed by the blue jay (the eater of snakes) is known to be life-giving nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਉ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਕੋਇਲ ਬੋਲੀ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਭਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: kaau na bhaavai boliaa koil bolee sabhanaa(n) bhaanee|

en.bdb: Crowing of the crow is disliked but the sound of nightingale is loved by all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਬੋਲਾ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵਈ ਮਿਠ ਬੋਲਾ ਜਗਿ ਮਿਤੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: burabolaa na sukhaaviee miTh bolaa jag mit viddaanee|

en.bdb: Evil speaker is not liked but the sweet tongued is praised all over the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸੈਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਸਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: buraa bhalaa saisaar vich paraupakaar vikaar nisaanee|

en.bdb: Evil and good persons live in the same world but they are distinguished by their qualities of benevolent and perverted actions.
We have here exposed the position of merits and demerits.
